data.name: Cleanup.windows-temp.Explanation
data.value: Files left by installations and updates. Files from the last 24 hours are kept.

data.name: Cleanup.user-temp.Explanation
data.value: Files left by programs in your temporary folder. Files from the last 24 hours are kept.

data.name: Cleanup.wu-download.Explanation
data.value: Installation files of updates already installed. Windows downloads them again if needed.

data.name: Cleanup.crash-dumps.Explanation
data.value: Memory copies made during blue screens. Keep them if you want to analyse a recent blue screen.

data.name: Cleanup.shader-caches.Explanation
data.value: Rebuilt automatically; games may load a little slower the first time.

data.name: Cleanup.chrome-cache.Explanation
data.value: Copies of visited pages. Your history, passwords and sessions are kept. Close Chrome for a complete cleanup.

data.name: Cleanup.edge-cache.Explanation
data.value: Copies of visited pages. Your history, passwords and sessions are kept. Close Edge for a complete cleanup.

data.name: Cleanup.firefox-cache.Explanation
data.value: Copies of visited pages. Your history, passwords and sessions are kept. Close Firefox for a complete cleanup.

data.name: Cleanup.recycle-bin.Explanation
data.value: Files you deleted. Emptying the Recycle Bin is permanent: check it first.

data.name: Cleanup.component-store.Explanation
data.value: Removes old versions of components replaced by updates (DISM). Takes several minutes; the updates can no longer be uninstalled afterwards.

data.name: Cleanup.Intro
data.value: Choose what to remove. Only temporary files and caches are deleted; your documents are never touched.

data.name: Cleanup.BigFilesIntro
data.value: The 30 biggest files (over 500 MB) in your Downloads, Desktop, Documents and Videos. PCDoc never deletes them: decide for yourself.

data.name: Cleanup.chrome-cookies.Explanation
data.value: Sites forget you: you will have to sign in again everywhere. Chrome must be closed.

data.name: Cleanup.chrome-history.Explanation
data.value: Visited sites and most-visited tiles. Bookmarks and passwords are kept. Chrome must be closed.

data.name: Cleanup.edge-cookies.Explanation
data.value: Sites forget you: you will have to sign in again everywhere. Edge must be fully closed (also turn off "Startup boost" in its settings if it stays open in the background).

data.name: Cleanup.edge-history.Explanation
data.value: Visited sites and most-visited tiles. Favorites and passwords are kept. Edge must be fully closed (Startup boost keeps it open in the background).

data.name: Cleanup.firefox-cookies.Explanation
data.value: Sites forget you: you will have to sign in again everywhere. Firefox must be closed. History and bookmarks are kept.

data.name: Cleanup.recent-files.Explanation
data.value: Empties "Recent" in File Explorer and Start. Your files themselves are not touched.

data.name: Cleanup.jump-lists.Explanation
data.value: Recent items shown when right-clicking a taskbar icon; items pinned in these lists are removed too. Folders pinned in File Explorer's Quick Access are kept.

data.name: Cleanup.thumbnail-cache.Explanation
data.value: Windows recreates the picture previews when needed. Files in use are skipped.

data.name: Erase.Files.Explanation
data.value: The content is overwritten with random data before deletion: undelete tools cannot recover it. No restore point is made (it would keep a copy). Copies kept elsewhere are not erased: older restore points or Previous Versions, File History, OneDrive or other cloud copies. Cloud-only, compressed, encrypted or sparse files are refused. On an SSD this is not fully guaranteed (protect an SSD with BitLocker). Cannot be undone.

data.name: Erase.Free.Explanation
data.value: Overwrites the space where deleted files used to be (Windows cipher /w), so they cannot be recovered. Your current files are not touched. Can take several hours.

data.name: Erase.Intro
data.value: Choose files or folders (or type a path), then erase them for good. Windows, programs, user folders roots and PCDoc's own folders are refused.

data.name: Erase.FreeSpace
data.value: Wipe the free space of the drive:

data.name: Erase.Refused
data.value: This path cannot be erased (system, programs, a user folder root, PCDoc or a whole drive).

data.name: Erase.TooMany
data.value: At most 200 items at a time.
